newsitem.title: UK: UK preliminary Q1 GDP rises 1.0 pct vs Q4.
newsitem.headline: UK preliminary Q1 GDP rises 1.0 pct vs Q4.

text.p: Statistics released the following preliminary UK gross domestic
product data for the first quarter of 1997. Data as last
NOTE - Q1 GDP forecast up 0.9 quarter on quarter and up 2.9
GDP EXCLUDING OIL AND GAS EXTRACTION
The ONS said output of the production industries was estimated to be broadly similar to that in the fourth quarter.
This was due to an increase in manufacturing output. The output of electricity, gas and water supply industries fell.
The ONS said the output of service industries is estimated to have grown at a similar rate to the fourth quarter. In the fourth quarter, services rose 1.1 percent over Q3.
Within the service sector, business services continued to show the highest growth. The finance, communication, catering and non-motor distribution industries also grew strongly.
The last time the economy grew faster was in Q1 1995 when it grew 3.5 percent year-on-year.
The next estimate of first quarter GDP will be published on May 22, when hard data are available for income and expenditure.
A full set of national accounts will be issued on June 27 whilst preliminary second quarter GDP will be released on July 25, the ONS said.
